body:
tasha: Quick design huddle — proposing a compact "first-run tour" anchored to the right of the console header. Shows three micro-steps: Connect, Try sample, Watch tour. Collapsible, keyboard-focusable, and dismissible. Thoughts?
igor: Love the smaller footprint. Concern: current mock uses 12px labels on pale bg — fails contrast. Bump to 14px and stronger color.
mike: Also need clear focus order and an accessible expand action. If collapsed, ensure a visible affordance (not just color).
olivia: For mobile, collapse to a single chip that opens a bottom sheet. Ensure tap targets >=44px. Use icons + text so color isn't the only state.
accessibility-bot: Checklist: focusable elements, aria-expanded on the control, aria-live polite updates when a step completes, announce dismiss action, avoid color-only indicators, meet 4.5:1 contrast for small text.
tasha: Copy variants to test: A) "Start tour" B) "Get set up" C) "Try a sample project". Preference? We'll A/B test.
igor: "Try a sample project" is explicit. But shorter CTAs like "Start tour" fit the compact UI. Track funnel: tour_impression -> tour_expand -> sample_run.
mike: Dismiss logic: soft dismiss (hide for 7 days) vs permanent opt-out via "Don't show again". Respect org admin settings and provide restore via Help > Onboarding.
olivia: Tiny nit: close button aria-label should be "Dismiss first-run tour" not just "Close". Also announce via SR when dismissed.
tasha: I'll update Figma with 14px labels, visible focus styles, and mobile sheet behavior. Posting updated frames in #design tomorrow and will spin up an experiment for copy variants. Thanks! :sparkles:
